dedupe_keys.name: huawei derived topology aware virtual machine placement instances

description: This dataset provides inputs for testing topology-aware placement of virtual machines in cloud data centres. The maintainer describes the inputs as derived from Huawei Cloud production practice and publishes a topology workbook, a physical-server resource workbook and five request-sequence workbooks. Documented attributes include available CPU cores, memory requirements, NUMA configuration and labels for collocation, anti-collocation or fault-domain constraints. All physical servers are modelled as dual-NUMA machines. Geographic coverage, observation dates, request timing and the degree of anonymisation are not established in the README. XLS and XLSX files are publicly accessible free under the repository’s CC0 1.0 dedication. A limitation is the short field documentation: detailed memory units, scale and mapping conventions require further examination before combining the instances with another model. These are placement experiments, not a documented census of an operating cloud. Simulation uses include evaluating capacity allocation, placement constraints and failure-domain sensitivity. No related catalogue resource was identified as this instance set or a direct dependency. Workbooks were listed but not downloaded, and no optimisation algorithm or feasibility result was reproduced.
